reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet that tears open with one hand, since I travel twice a month and a bottle of capsules is a pain in a carry-on. The QR on every sachet for the lab report is a nice touch, so I'd try one box of the bisglycinate for sleep.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? $30 for a month is a lot to spend on something that may do nothing noticeable.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a creator I trust show real before and after sleep results, or a money-back guarantee if I don't notice anything in the first box.
